title: Toll-Free Roads
statement: A region has n towns numbered 0 to n − 1 and two-way roads [a, b, toll], where toll is 0 (a free road) or 1 (a toll road). Return the fewest toll roads a driver must use to get from town 0 to town n − 1, or −1 if it cannot be reached.

answerKey.pattern: 0-1 BFS with a deque: free roads go to the front, toll roads to the back
keyPoints: dist[0] = 0; a deque instead of a queue
A free road keeps the distance and pushes to the front
A toll road adds one and pushes to the back
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Dijkstra with a heap: O((n + m) log n), also correct
Plain BFS: wrong, it counts roads instead of tolls

hints: Plain BFS counts roads. What changes when some roads cost nothing?
A free road should not move a town to the next BFS level.
Use a deque: push to the front for toll 0 and to the back for toll 1.
